From cc76404feaed597bb4f5234d34d3f49e2d1139bf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wen Yang <wen.yang99@zte.com.cn>
Date: Tue, 26 Mar 2019 18:29:51 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] powerpc/8xx: Fix possible device node reference leak

The call to of_find_compatible_node() returns a node pointer with
refcount incremented thus it must be explicitly decremented after the
last usage.

irq_domain_add_linear() also calls of_node_get() to increase refcount,
so irq_domain() will not be affected when it is released.

Detected by coccinelle.

Fixes: a8db8cf0d894 ("irq_domain: Replace irq_alloc_host() with revmap-specific initializers")
Signed-off-by: Wen Yang <wen.yang99@zte.com.cn>
Suggested-by: Christophe Leroy <christophe.leroy@c-s.fr>
Suggested-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>
Reviewed-by: Peng Hao <peng.hao2@zte.com.cn>
Reviewed-by: Christophe Leroy <christophe.leroy@c-s.fr>
Signed-off-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>

diff --git a/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c b/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c
index 8d5a25d43ef3..e9617d35fd1f 100644
--- a/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c
+++ b/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c
@@ -153,10 +153,9 @@ int mpc8xx_pic_init(void)
 	if (mpc8xx_pic_host == NULL) {
 		printk(KERN_ERR "MPC8xx PIC: failed to allocate irq host!\n");
 		ret = -ENOMEM;
-		goto out;
 	}
-	return 0;
 
+	ret = 0;
 out:
 	of_node_put(np);
 	return ret;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c`**
   - The code block that handles the return value when `mpc8xx_pic_host` is `NULL` has been modified. 
   - The `goto out;` statement has been removed, and instead, the return value `ret` is set to `0` before the `out:` label.
   - The `of_node_put(np);` function call is retained in the `out:` label to ensure that the reference count of the device node is decremented properly, preventing a potential reference leak.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a potential device node reference leak that was identified in the context of the `of_find_compatible_node()` function, which increments the reference count of the node pointer. 
- By ensuring that `of_node_put(np);` is called in all exit paths of the function, the patch maintains proper reference counting and resource management, thus fixing the bug introduced by a previous commit (`a8db8cf0d894`) that altered how IRQ domains were initialized. 
- The changes ensure that the reference count is decremented appropriately, thus preventing memory leaks related to device node references.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
np = of_find_compatible_node(NULL, NULL, "fsl,pq1-pic");
```
```c
mpc8xx_pic_host = irq_domain_add_linear(np, 64, &mpc8xx_pic_host_ops, NULL);
```
```c
// Missing of_node_put(np);
```
Reason:
The function `of_find_compatible_node()` increments the reference count of the device node pointer `np`. If `np` is not properly decremented using `of_node_put()` before the function exits, it results in a memory leak because the reference count remains higher than expected, preventing the memory from being freed.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
of_node_put(np);
```
```c
ret = 0;
```
Reason:
The addition of `of_node_put(np);` ensures that the reference count of the device node pointer `np` is decremented, thus properly releasing the reference and preventing a memory leak. The line `ret = 0;` is added to ensure that the function returns a success code when the initialization is successful, maintaining the expected behavior of the function.
